resources.string: No log yet — start the game once.
The log is empty. It is written while the game runs and survives a crash, so try starting the game and coming back here.
%1$d files from the original Dungeon Keeper are missing
Searching for the original game files…
Tap "Install KeeperFX" to download the current release, or import a folder you already have.
Still missing from an original Dungeon Keeper:
The app, the game data and the music are all current.\n\nFiles from an original Dungeon Keeper cannot be downloaded — use "Import original Dungeon Keeper" for those.
Installing the game data replaces the current installation, so the files from the original game have to be imported again afterwards.
To install its own update, KeeperFX needs permission to install apps. Grant it once in the settings screen that follows, then start the update again.

Downloads %1$s from keeperfx.net and unpacks it. The archive is around 360 MB, so use Wi-Fi.\n\nThis replaces the current installation, including the files copied from the original game — import those again afterwards. Save games are lost.
Use this instead of downloading if you already have a KeeperFX installation on this device. Pick its folder; it is copied into the app\'s private storage.

KeeperFX cannot ship a few files that must come from an original Dungeon Keeper. Pick your Dungeon Keeper folder — the one containing DATA and SOUND — and they are picked out and copied automatically.\n\nA mounted or extracted CD image works too. Nothing else from that folder is copied.
Could not apply the bundled configuration
Removes the installation including save games. The folders you imported from are not touched.
